contractVersion.description: Strict semver contract version carried by every wire object. Decoders accept the same major version; any other version is a typed error.

intentRef.description: The intent event this negotiation answered (echo of intentId).

missingParameters.description: blocked outcome: the required parameter names missing from the intent, in the profile's declaration order (the agent's clarification-question driver). Empty otherwise.

outcome.description: executable (capability declared and parameters present) | blocked (required parameters missing — ask, never invent) | unsupported (definitively not supported) | unknown (capability undetermined; never conflated with unsupported).

profileRef.description: The engine capability profile this negotiation used (echo of profileId).

reasons.description: NEVER empty: executable carries capability-satisfied (plus capability-degraded with the surfaced limitations when the declared status is degraded); every refusal carries its honest reason.

detail.description: Honest deterministic reason text — names the vertical, operation type or parameter and the declaring profile.
